title: Reference HUD and immersive sailing evidence

humanReview.feedback: es cierto quedó muy bien sigamos man que falta?
humanReview.accepted: Visual appearance of B4a HUD in the conversation after delivery.
humanReview.limits: Does not establish physical-device FPS, gamepad acceptance, B2 normal/mipmap calibration, or deployment.

source.comparison: SHA-256 of working files and commit blobs after normalizing CRLF and lone CR to LF; all six selected files match.
source.checkoutNote: This evidence compares the selected HUD paths only and does not claim a clean full checkout.

checks.reportedBy: root agent; not rerun for this evidence record

captures.method: ffprobe measured image dimensions; hashes, byte counts, and JPEG signatures were read from the original files. Captures are ignored workspace evidence and were not edited.

hudImages.relationToFinal: Their artwork and HUD are visually identical in final source commit 825e96e4496418b0142c72d2e63cc6653a362b6e.

portraitSettings.detail: Captured with the final settings scroll helper.

uiAndInputProofs.relationToFinal: The relevant UI and input source files are unchanged in 825e96e4496418b0142c72d2e63cc6653a362b6e.

settingsPanel.reviewNote: Root confirmed the refreshed portrait-settings.jpg shows the settings panel in the final 825e96e UI.

interactionEvidence.reportedBy: root agent; UI event sequences were run in the real lab interface

keyboard.sequence: With focus on the settings button labeled '← Volver a navegar', press J and then Space. J does not jettison cargo; Space activates the focused native button, closes settings, and does not capture a gust. These focused key behaviors are not global key blocking.

interactionEvidence.togglePauseSnapshot: toggle-pause.json was omitted because it predates the final helper.

responsiveAndAssetBudget.measuredControls: Across desktop, portrait, landscape, 320px small portrait, and native viewports, all measured controls are at least 44px high and the recorded control rectangles have zero overlapping pairs.
responsiveAndAssetBudget.review: Root visually reviewed the five viewport layouts; the refreshed portrait settings capture shows the settings panel.
responsiveAndAssetBudget.rasterNote: The reference HUD adds no raster image loads; mobile UI snapshots report only the existing 512x512 raft albedo and no normal map.
responsiveAndAssetBudget.limits: Evidence does not measure physical-device GPU or FPS, and does not establish gamepad acceptance, user acceptance, or a production deployment.

assetReuse.handling: Same candidates confirmed for B4; neither source was modified, exported, or previewed.
assetReuse.iconDesign: Wind and crate icons are manually redrawn as fixed inline SVG. The mastbolt icon was reused historically in B4, then replaced by wind curves in B4a; mastbolt reuse is not part of the final B4a HUD.
